description: This file defines the internal class 'CachedMessagePool' in the 'Orleans.Providers.Streams.Common' namespace. It manages a pool of cached message blocks to reduce garbage collection pressure in stream-based messaging systems, providing methods for allocating and managing message blocks.

classes.name: CachedMessagePool
classes.description: Manages a pool of CachedMessageBlock objects, allocating message blocks and handling message assignment efficiently to minimize garbage collection overhead.

methods.name: CachedMessagePool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message pool with the specified cache data adapter.

methods.name: AllocateMessage
methods.description: Allocates a cached message within the current message block, or creates a new block if the current is full, and returns the block used for the message.
